entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: evaluation reaches outside %s to %s, the span lowering represents exactly: %w
entries.rationale: unreachable from the HTTP query endpoints: the prom handler's query and query_range paths ask LeavesEvaluationDomain, the same predicate this site guards on, before anything is lowered, and answer a true verdict with the reference PromQL engine reading samples through LowerSampleRead, which skips this check; only a caller lowering through Lower or LowerAtRangeOpts directly reaches it
